Take into account that the measurements, simulations and other experiments are expensive. Try always to minimize costs and avoid unnecessary actions.

Task Guide: Task: 
Task: Aluminum Bulk Minimisation for Surface Energy - Level 1
Description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible Aluminum structure file and EAM potential file, perform bulk relaxation using the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.

Required submission format:
{"BULK ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"BULK ENERGY": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structure/structure.dat"}


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/.

- Input from aluminum_surface_1_subtask_structure_retrieval: /results/claude_35/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/aluminum_surface_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_4/Al.data

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- atom_style: atomic

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/claude_35/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/aluminum_surface_1_bulk_energy_minimisation_trial_4 when using tools use this path.
